worldcombat.skill.dragonclaw.summary: The user plants itself, raises both claws and rakes a crossing pair of giant claw bands across a wide front: both bands resolve at once, and every enemy caught by either band takes one contact hit. Only a target in the crossing centre, covered by both bands, has its armour torn open and its Defence lowered; a target nicked by a single band at the edge is only hurt. It is the family's only move that weakens armour.
worldcombat.skill.dragonclaw.use.0: Rake a crossing pair of giant claw bands across the front
worldcombat.skill.dragonclaw.use.1: Catch several foes in one sweep
worldcombat.skill.dragonclaw.use.2: Aim the crossing centre to tear an armoured target's Defence down
worldcombat.skill.dragonclaw.description: Rakes two crossing claw bands in front, each about %2$s blocks long and %3$s blocks half-wide; up to 6 foes are caught, and each target caught by either band takes about %1$s contact damage once.

The bands cross at about %1$s degrees and cover to about %2$s blocks high; only a target in the crossing centre covered by both bands loses %3$s Defence stages, taking heavier physical hits until combat ends, while an edge target nicked by one band is only hurt.
worldcombat.skill.dragonclaw.cross.on: Cross form: the band angle widens from 84 to %1$s degrees and tears %2$s armour stages, each caught target about %3$s damage, but with a longer wind-up, recovery and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.dragonclaw.cross.off: Single-claw form: narrower bands (%1$s degrees) and %2$s armour stages, each caught target about %3$s damage, with a faster wind-up and shorter cycle.
worldcombat.skill.dragonclaw.timing: Reach %1$s blocks; %2$s seconds of wind-up, %3$s seconds of recovery, %4$s PP, then a %5$s second cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.dragonclaw.growth.0: At level %1$s claw power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.dragonclaw.growth.1: At level %1$s claw power rises to %2$s and the reach to %3$s blocks.
On (cross): the base band angle goes from 84 to 140 degrees, 2 armour stages torn and a wider sweep, at the cost of power ×0.9, +3 ticks of wind-up, +2 of recovery and +6 of cooldown. Off (single claw): narrower bands (base 84 degrees) but ×1.06 per target, 1 armour stage, and a faster wind-up and cycle.
